question: Does post-consensus PriorityScore systematically align with wider conservative planned stop distance, thereby amplifying projected stop-risk under score-proportional sizing?
unit: generation-certified selected name within scan date
primaryMetrics: current projected-risk HHI minus equal-capital projected-risk HHI
share of multi-selected dates where highest-score name also has widest stopRiskPct

falsificationDirections.amplification: positive score-stop association and current risk concentration above equal-capital across independent dates
falsificationDirections.neutralization: association centered near zero and no stable excess risk concentration
falsificationDirections.naturalOffset: negative score-stop association and current risk concentration at/below equal-capital

forbidden: pool all names across dates and call cross-sectional correlation causal
interpret planned stop-risk as realized loss
infer factor-level cause from final PriorityScore
minimumEvidence: multiple independent multi-selected dates; no optimization candidacy from one date
timestampProvenance: Corrected to GitHub PR creation time; do not use prior manually estimated clock value as evidence ordering.
